title: The Spider Silk
text: Webs hang between the trees, thick as rope and strong as steel, glistening with dew. Wrapped bundles hang in them, some the size of deer, some the size of people. The spiders are elsewhere, for now.

options.label: Harvest the silk while the spiders are elsewhere.

outcomes.text: You take bolts of it. Nobody opens the bundles.

options.label: Burn the webs and everything wrapped in them.

outcomes.text: The wood is clear. Somewhere, the spiders are angry.

options.label: The wisest studies how it is spun so the House can weave its like.

outcomes.text: It is a weaver's trick, and the House's looms will learn it.
